content.text: Robinhood launched its blockchain on July 1 to move stocks onchain. Eight days later, the first breakout hit is a memecoin called CASHCAT, with one early buyer walking away with over $1 million between his sale and remaining tokens. CoinDesk's Jennifer Sanasie hosts "CoinDesk Daily."
